scope: Native configuration source selection, current export provenance and final finish acceptance

configuration.trigger: Same-style custom-color application raised RuntimeError: Cyclic dependency at ActiveFrame.setLink(cover).
configuration.cause: App::Link inherits FrameStyle and was eligible in the frame-source lookup; the active link could be selected before the appended source for its own style.
configuration.correction: Exclude App::Link from frame-source candidates, as already done for battery source candidates.
configuration.prevention: Retain the existing full fourteen-style loop followed by same-style custom color edit and native save/reopen assertions.
configuration.acceptance: Full corrected finish run and independent mixed-configuration run passed on the unchanged saved native.

provenance.trigger: Current metadata inherited the prior label-only export execution object.
provenance.correction: Keep the old object as historical_export_execution and bind the current full saved-reference export to native, exporter and mechanical receipt hashes.

numeric_datum_correction.trigger: Full delivery gate rejected 3.8 versus 3.8000000000000003 mm after PCBTop minus PCBThickness.
numeric_datum_correction.cause: Exact equality compared a reported nominal decimal with its binary floating-point subtraction.
numeric_datum_correction.correction: Require exactly two datum values and an absolute difference at most 1e-8 mm, consistent with the analytic bounds precision check. All physical geometry, calibration and Boolean guards remain unchanged.
numeric_datum_correction.validation: Complete aggregate delivery gate passed after correction; current receipt independently binds all checked inputs.
